name: Yoshikawa-san no Junan
source:
Yoshikawa is a quiet girl who responds to an invitation for a part time job. However, she is put to sleep with a drug.

During her sleep she is raped by a large number of men, who ejaculate into her mouth and onto her face until she is drenched in semen...

This is an original short story about gang banging a sleeping girl.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE039341.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
吉川是一个安静的女孩，她接受了打工的邀请。然而，她被药物催眠。

在她睡觉时，她被大量男人强奸，这些男人将精液射入她的嘴里和脸上，直到她被精液浸透……

这是一个关于轮奸熟睡女孩的原创短篇故事。
